page-white.$description: Page White — Page background, card surfaces, button text on blue

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary heading text, heavy borders, icon fills, image framing

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text, nav text, secondary borders — slightly softer than pure black for long-form readability

granite.$description: Granite — Muted helper text, secondary descriptions

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, disabled states, fine metadata

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline dividers, nav accents, light surface variation

wash-blue.$description: Wash Blue — Soft blue surface wash for highlighted sections and subtle backgrounds

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Primary CTA fills, active link borders, key accent — the only chromatic color allowed to draw the eye

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Lighter blue for link text and secondary outlined actions

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

satoshi.$description: Primary display and UI font — used for all headlines at extreme sizes (93–120px) with weight 700 and tight tracking; also for body at 15px weight 400. Satoshi's geometric, slightly humanist forms give the type a modern, builder-friendly character. The decision to run 93–120px display sizes is signature — most builder sites cap at 48–64px, and this scale creates editorial monumentality.

inter.$description: Input field text — the only context where Inter appears, used for form input legibility where Satoshi's tighter geometry could feel cramped.

system-ui.$description: System fallback and minor inline elements. Acts as the safety net for Satoshi; not visually load-bearing.
